name: Albert Einstein
hook: E=mc², the patent office, and the Nobel he won for something else.

facts.statement: Einstein was born in Germany in 1879 and died in April 1955; his brain was preserved and his ashes scattered in the Delaware River.

facts.label: the Swiss patent office
facts.statement: Fired as a tutor in 1902, Einstein got a job as a clerk in the Swiss patent office after Marcel Grossmann's father recommended him to its director.

facts.label: the theory of relativity
facts.statement: Einstein published the special theory of relativity in 1905 and the general theory in 1915; the 2021 Einstein Prize honored tests of general relativity.

facts.label: E=mc²
facts.statement: Introduced in 1905 in a short paper, E=mc² says energy equals mass times the speed of light squared.

facts.label: the Nobel Prize in Physics
facts.statement: Einstein won the Nobel Prize in Physics for the photoelectric effect, not for relativity.

facts.label: Princeton, New Jersey
facts.statement: From 1933 until his death Einstein worked at the Institute for Advanced Study in Princeton, New Jersey.

facts.label: the presidency of Israel
facts.statement: Israel offered Einstein its presidency in 1952, and he politely declined.
